title: Mapping primate brain aging across cell types, regions, and sexes
title_zh: 细胞类型、脑区和性别的人脑老化图谱
abstract: Aging is the major risk factor for neurodegenerative disease, yet how it affects different cells in the primate brain remains unclear. In this issue of Cell, Yang et al. present a single-nucleus atlas of the aging macaque brain that, together with recent work by Zhang et al., reveals context-dependent aging programs, sex-biased transcriptional aging, and molecular links to Alzheimer's disease.
abstract_zh: 衰老是神经退行性疾病的主要风险因素，但衰老如何影响非人灵长类大脑中的不同细胞尚不清楚。在《细胞》（Cell）本期中，Yang 等人提供了衰老猕猴大脑的单细胞核图谱，结合张等人的近期研究，揭示了情境依赖的老化程序、性别偏向的转录老化以及与阿尔茨海默病的分子关联。
